verdict.rationale: FFmpeg exposes public C library APIs (libavformat, libavfilter, libavdevice, hwaccel and AVChannelLayout APIs). They are documented through nightly-regenerated Doxygen reference docs and coding examples in doc/examples, and a community user confirms working with the C API directly. Community reports that libav API docs and tutorials are sparse or outdated, and that the API makes invalid states easy, which lowers quality but does not contradict that the API exists. missing for 10: clear, up-to-date API guides and tutorials beyond the Doxygen reference; AI-friendly machine-readable docs (llms.txt and markdown docs both 404); independent corroboration that the API is easy to drive programmatically.
